Reinforced_Sturgeon_Scutes.description: The reinforced sturgeon scutes form a heavy, piscine armor that grants the wearer unparalleled natural protection, though its cumbersome nature hinders agility and quick movement.

Slippery_Eel_Mucus_Coating.description: A layer of slippery eel mucus coats the skin, granting the bearer unparalleled agility and stealth, enhancing their ability to evade attacks and move silently across any terrain.

Iridescent_Koi_Scales.description: The Iridescent Koi Scales, shimmering with a kaleidoscope of colors that shift and blend like the depths of a tranquil lake, grant an ethereal beauty that enhances one's charisma and offers a subtle wisdom, allowing the bearer to charm and captivate those around them with an enchanting allure.

Camouflaging_Flounder_Skin.description: The flounder's skin, mottled and shifting like the ocean floor, grants the wearer unparalleled stealth in aquatic environments, allowing them to blend seamlessly with their surroundings and strike with deadly precision.

Spiky_Pufferfish_Hide.description: This pufferfish-derived hide, rigid with spikes and imbued with toxic mucus, provides an additional layer of natural armor and boosts one's constitution, granting the wearer the skills to inflict bleeding damage, summon poison clouds, and resist toxic attacks.

Bioluminescent_Anglerfish_Skin.description: This eerie, translucent skin, derived from the depths of the ocean, pulses with a soft, otherworldly glow, enhancing the wearer's wisdom and perception, and granting them the uncanny ability to emit light and lure prey or foes into treacherous traps.

Tough_Shark_Dermal_Denticles.description: Embedded with microscopic, razor-sharp scales akin to those of a shark, this component grants the bearer a second skin that enhances their agility and provides a natural, armor-like defense, allowing them to slip through dangers with ease and deliver swift, deadly strikes.

Electric_Eel_Discharge_Skin.description: Enveloped in a sleek, shimmering skin that pulses with electric currents, this piscine integument not only grants unparalleled agility and reflexes but also imbues the bearer with a defensive magic that reflects hostile spells back upon their caster.

Ghost_Koi_Spectral_Scales.description: The Ghost Koi's spectral scales shimmer with an otherworldly glow, blending seamlessly with the shadows as it glides through the water, its undead-like presence granting it unparalleled stealth and the ability to vanish from sight, leaving only a faint, elusive trail of shimmering light.

Deep_Sea_Jellyfish_Membrane.description: The Deep Sea Jellyfish Membrane, a translucent layer imbued with the fluid grace and lethal toxicity of the abyssal depths, enhances agility and resilience while granting the wielder the eerie ability to emit a poisonous cloud, striking fear and paralysis into the hearts of their foes.
